title: TIMERANGE_NOW() on the Lakewatch query page uses the selected time range
body: On the Lakewatch query page, `TIMERANGE_NOW()` now returns the end of the selected time range instead of the current time, so you can test a detection rule's predicates against historical data. See [Reference the run's window with `TIMERANGE_NOW()`](/aws/en/lakewatch/detections/write-detection-rules#reference-the-runs-window-with-timerange_now).
